RNA-Seq workflow: gene-level exploratory analysis and differential expression
Love, Anders, Kim, Huber. F1000Research 2015, 4:1070. PMC4670015.

RNA-seq reads (SRR1039520, project SRP033351) were downloaded from the Sequence Read Archive.
The reads were aligned to the Ensembl release 75 human reference genome (GRCh37) using the STAR read aligner.
STAR --genomeDir ENSEMBL.homo_sapiens.release-75 --readFilesIn fastq/SRR1039520_1.fastq fastq/SRR1039520_2.fastq --runThreadN 12
SAMtools was used to generate BAM files from the STAR SAM output.
Count matrices were generated with featureCounts (Rsubread) or summarizeOverlaps.
Differential expression was computed with DESeq2 using a design formula ~ cell + dex.
